newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SOCCER-STEAUA WITHOUT KEY DEFENDER AGAINST ATLETICO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-STEAUA WITHOUT KEY DEFENDER AGAINST ATLETICO.

text.p: Steaua Bucharest's key defender Tiberiu Csik will miss this week's European champions' league group B match against Atletico Madrid after being suspended for two bookable offences.
"We have very little choice in replacing Csik so Marius Miu, relatively young and inexperienced, will be in the line-up," Steaua's coach Dumitru Dumitriu told Reuters at the weekend.
Steaua Bucharest have no chance of reaching the champions' league quarter-finals after losing their last match 2-0 away to Widzew Lodz of Poland.
